'''Travin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as an [[Jedi instructor|instructor]] of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A [[Color/Legends|brown]]-skinned Zabrak with brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], Travin wore dark brown [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] with brown [[Boot/Legends|boots]] and brown [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] and carried a single [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in battle.<ref name="TOR" /> Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> during the [[Flesh Raider uprising|conflict]] between the [[Flesh Raider]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and the Order on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], Travin was stationed at the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Gnarls Outpost|outpost]] in the [[Tythonian Gnarls]] region.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Travin appears in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as a Jedi Knight trainer at the Gnarls Outpost on Tython.<ref name="TOR" />
